app_fee.value: USD 75 per application; each program applied to needs its own application and fee.
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable fee of $75 is charged for processing each application received by the Graduate School.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are need-based and need documents such as a FAFSA or CSS profile, or a GRE or TOEFL fee reduction voucher; apply at least two weeks before the program deadline.
fee_waiver.quote: To be eligible for a fee waiver, applicants to Brown University’s graduate programs must demonstrate financial need.

also.quote: We recommend submitting your application with a fee waiver request at least two weeks prior to your program submission deadline.

gre_general.value: Each program decides; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Each program at Brown University may choose to require applicants to submit their official results from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE), or not.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new scale (tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026); 90 on the old scale. Some programs set higher standards.
toefl_min.quote: For TOEFL exams taken on or after January 21, 2026: Minimum total score: 4.5

also.quote: For TOEFL exams taken before January 21, 2026: Minimum total score: 90

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 7 is the recommended minimum.
ielts_min.quote: For IELTS, the recommended minimum overall band score is 7.

english_waiver.value: India is not on Brown's country list, but a degree taught in English qualifies if your university Registrar or Dean sends the Graduate School a letter confirming English was the primary language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Language proficiency exams are not required of those students who have earned a degree from a non-U.S. university where the primary language of instruction is English | Students with degrees from universities in countries not on this list should have their university Registrar or Dean send a letter to the Graduate School, referencing the applicant's name and proposed area of study, stating that English is the primary language of instruction for that program or institution.

notes: Duolingo is not accepted. Public health programs (SPH) apply through SOPHAS.
